messages.subject: Nominal Response Model
parts:
Hello  all,

I tried to run Nominal Response Model (NRM) on Science dataset file which is accessible in ltm package.  When I put the argument of IRTpars=TRUE in “coef” function, I encountered the following error. I tried this code on other datasets and got the same error in all cases. No error was shown when I set the IRTpars=FALSE. I need parameter estimates in the framework of logistic IRT models. What do you suggest to solve this problem? Thank you for your help.

> nomod <- mirt(Science, 1, 'nominal') Iteration: 71, Log-Lik: -1608.455, Max-Change: 0.00007 > coef(nomod, simplify=TRUE, IRTpars=TRUE) Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, i, nms[[i]], value = items.old[[i]]) : subscript out of bounds > coef(nomod, simplify=TRUE, IRTpars=FALSE) $items a1 ak0 ak1 ak2 ak3 d0 d1 d2 d3 Comfort 1.008 0 1.541 1.999 3 0 3.639 5.905 4.533 Work 0.841 0 0.689 1.500 3 0 1.464 2.326 0.325 Future 2.041 0 0.762 1.861 3 0 3.668 5.867 3.949 Benefit 0.779 0 1.036 1.742 3 0 2.144 2.911 1.621 $means F1 0 $cov F1 F1 1

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Nominal Response Model
parts:
Hi Asghar,

This looks to be a recently introduced bug. The fix is on the dev version, though I'm currently in the process of releasing the next major version to CRAN, so you should be able to update and fix this problem by the end of the week. Thanks for the report!

Phil
